name: Monetary amount type code qualifier
description: Code qualifying the type of monetary amount.

values.name: VAT, 1st value
values.description: VAT, 1st value First VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 1 to 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: VAT, 2nd value
values.description: VAT, 2nd value Second VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 2 or 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: VAT, 3rd value
values.description: VAT, 3rd value Third VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: Additional royalties (Customs)
values.description: Additional royalties (Customs) Royalties relating to the imported goods that the buyer must pay, either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale, to the extent that they are not included in the price actually paid or payable.

values.name: Adjusted amount
values.description: Adjusted amount The amount specified is the adjusted amount.

values.name: Amount reference currency
values.description: Amount reference currency The owing amount in the currency used as reference in the transaction.

values.name: Agreed charge
values.description: Agreed charge Charges which parties agreed upon.

values.name: Allowance or charge amount
values.description: Allowance or charge amount Total amount of allowance or charge.

values.name: Amount due/amount payable
values.description: Amount due/amount payable Amount to be paid.

values.name: Amount in charge currency
values.description: Amount in charge currency Indicates that the amount is based on the charged currency.

values.name: Amount paid
values.description: Amount paid Amount that has been paid.

values.name: Amount remitted
values.description: Amount remitted Amount which was remitted (see remittance advice).

values.name: Amount subject to total monetary discount
values.description: Amount subject to total monetary discount The amount is subject to a total monetary discount.

values.name: Amount target currency
values.description: Amount target currency The amount in the currency in which the amount is paid or has to be paid.

values.name: Average ledger balance
values.description: Average ledger balance The addition of the balance all accounts divided by the number of accounts.

values.name: Bank release fee
values.description: Bank release fee The fee that a bank charges for releasing monies.

values.name: Batch total
values.description: Batch total The complete quantity of anything needed for or made in one operation or lot.

values.name: Brokerage
values.description: Brokerage Fee charged by a broker for acting on behalf of a third party.

values.name: Buying commission
values.description: Buying commission Commission paid by the importer to his/her agent for the service of representing him/her in the purchase.

values.name: Data value on carrier media (Customs)
values.description: Data value on carrier media (Customs) Value of data contained on the carrier media (e.g. magnetic tape).

values.name: Cash discount
values.description: Cash discount Cash discount given by the seller to the buyer.

values.name: Consignment cash on delivery amount
values.description: Consignment cash on delivery amount [5017] Monetary amount to be paid at time of delivery.

values.name: Charge amount
values.description: Charge amount The amount of money charged for the provision of a service or product.

values.name: Charge summary total
values.description: Charge summary total Code to indicate the total charges relating to a consignment.

values.name: Charge/allowance basis
values.description: Charge/allowance basis The amount specified is the basis for calculation of charges/allowance.

values.name: Charges collect fee
values.description: Charges collect fee The fee a party charges for collecting charges.

values.name: Charges in destination currency
values.description: Charges in destination currency Collect charges payable in the currency of the country of destination.

values.name: Collect charge summary total
values.description: Collect charge summary total A summary total of collection charges.

values.name: Collect charges in destination currency
values.description: Collect charges in destination currency Collect charges payable in the currency of the country of destination.

values.name: Collect freight charge including VAT
values.description: Collect freight charge including VAT This is the total amount that has to be collected from the consignee or other intermediary intervening party - Including VAT-.

values.name: Collect freight charge without VAT
values.description: Collect freight charge without VAT For legal accounting reasons the amount without VAT has to be announced, together with the amount of VAT.

values.name: Collect other charges due agent total
values.description: Collect other charges due agent total The total of other charges that are due to the agent.

values.name: Collect taxes total
values.description: Collect taxes total The total amount of taxes to be collected.

values.name: Collected balance required
values.description: Collected balance required A certain sum of money that must be kept in an account.

values.name: Container cost
values.description: Container cost The cost of providing a container.

values.name: Converted amount
values.description: Converted amount The amount is converted from another currency.

values.name: Credit on consignment
values.description: Credit on consignment Credit deducted from the total invoice amount for the value of goods not included in a consignment but included in the invoice.

values.name: Invoice total amount
values.description: Invoice total amount [5214] Amount, debited by the seller and being the total of related article item amounts in a commercial invoice.

values.name: Goods item for customs declared value amount
values.description: Goods item for customs declared value amount [5032] Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

values.name: Assigned Customs value
values.description: Assigned Customs value Goods value assigned by Customs.

values.name: Total cash payments received by factor
values.description: Total cash payments received by factor Total allocated amount of cash payments received by a factor.

values.name: Consignment for customs total amount
values.description: Consignment for customs total amount [5070] Total amount for customs purposes of all goods in a consignment, whether or not they are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

values.name: Goods item for carriage declared value amount
values.description: Goods item for carriage declared value amount [5036] Value, declared by the shipper or his agent solely for the purpose of varying the carrier's level of liability from that provided in the contract of carriage, in case of loss or damage to goods or delayed delivery.

values.name: Deductible after importation charges (Customs)
values.description: Deductible after importation charges (Customs) Charges (e.g. construction, assembly, erection, maintenance or technical assistance) after importation, which are included in the total invoice price, that may be deducted to arrive at a Customs value.

values.name: Customs allowable deduction basis amount
values.description: Customs allowable deduction basis amount [5020] Allowable deductions from the price payable for calculating Customs value.

values.name: Delivery fee
values.description: Delivery fee Fees incurred by delivery.

values.name: Deposit total
values.description: Deposit total The whole amount of money that one entrusts for safekeeping.

values.name: Development necessary for production of imported goods
values.description: Development necessary for production of imported goods (Customs) Value of engineering, development, artwork, design work and plans and sketches carried out elsewhere than in the Customs territory and necessary for the production of the imported goods.

values.name: Disbursements
values.description: Disbursements Amount of disbursements to be collected by the carrier according to the order given by the shipper.

values.name: Disbursements fee
values.description: Disbursements fee Fee charged for the collection of disbursements.

values.name: Discount amount
values.description: Discount amount An amount deducted in advance, usually calculated based on a percentage.

values.name: Discount amount due
values.description: Discount amount due The amount of discount that is due.

values.name: Distribution service fee
values.description: Distribution service fee The fee charged for the provision of distribution services.

values.name: Duty amount
values.description: Duty amount The amount of duty.

values.name: Duty/tax/fee basis amount
values.description: Duty/tax/fee basis amount The amount specified is the basis for duty/tax or fee.

values.name: Equivalent amount
values.description: Equivalent amount This amount is equivalent to the amount to be transferred, but in another currency.

values.name: Fee amount
values.description: Fee amount The amount of a fee.

values.name: Fees paid year to date
values.description: Fees paid year to date Payments made for goods thus far.

values.name: Final (posted) amount
values.description: Final (posted) amount The amount posted to an account, finally, after charges/allowances.

values.name: Float (e.g. "cash float")
values.description: Float (e.g. "cash float") The status of funds in the process of collection.

values.name: Total payments on account received by a factor
values.description: Total payments on account received by a factor Total unallocated amount of payments received by a factor.

values.name: FOB value
values.description: FOB value Identifies the value of the shipment free on board, named port of shipment (see FOB Incoterm of ICC).

values.name: Freight charge
values.description: Freight charge Amount to be paid for moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another, inclusive discounts, allowances, rebates, adjustment factors and additional cost relating to freight costs (UN/ECE Recommendation no 23).

values.name: Total indirect amount payments made to a seller or his
values.description: Total indirect amount payments made to a seller or his agent instead of to a factor Total indirect amount of payments made to a seller or his agent instead of to a factor.

values.name: Goods item total
values.description: Goods item total Net price x quantity for the line item.

values.name: Insurance amount
values.description: Insurance amount Amount of insurance.

values.name: Insurance and transport charges (Customs)
values.description: Insurance and transport charges (Customs) (5488)+(5290) Sum total of transport and insurance charges (CCC).

values.name: Insurance and transport charges incurred outside Customs
values.description: Insurance and transport charges incurred outside Customs territory (5488)+(5290) Insurance and transport charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Consignment to importation location insurance amount
values.description: Consignment to importation location insurance amount [5488] Amount of premium payable to the insurance company to insure the goods to the port or place of importation.

values.name: Insurance charges incurred outside of Customs territory
values.description: Insurance charges incurred outside of Customs territory (5488) Insurance charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Internal charges (Customs)
values.description: Internal charges (Customs) Charges incurred within a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Total amount of payments booked to the collateral account
values.description: Total amount of payments booked to the collateral account Total amount of payments booked to the collateral account.

values.name: Amount to be paid in advance
values.description: Amount to be paid in advance Amount which is to be paid before goods are delivered or the service is rendered.

values.name: Registered capital
values.description: Registered capital Registered amount of equity of a company.

values.name: Investable balance
values.description: Investable balance To put left over money in something offering profitable returns.

values.name: Invoice line item amount
values.description: Invoice line item amount [5068] Total sum charged with respect to a single line item of an invoice.

values.name: Landing charges
values.description: Landing charges The charges incurred in landing the goods into store in the country of importation, excluding Customs duties and taxes.

values.name: Total line items amount
values.description: Total line items amount The sum of all the line item amounts.

values.name: Licence fees related to imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Licence fees related to imported goods (Customs) Licence fees relating to the imported goods that the buyer must pay, either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale, to the extent that they are not included in the price actually paid or payable.

values.name: Loading and handling cost
values.description: Loading and handling cost Cost incurred by loading and handling.

values.name: Lock box total
values.description: Lock box total The complete amount of funds that customers mailed in to a specific location. Often times funds are sent to a post-office lock box in their city.

values.name: Lumpsum
values.description: Lumpsum An agreed sum of money, which is paid in full at one time. This term is often used in connection with charter parties.

values.name: Material consumed in production of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Material consumed in production of imported goods (Customs) Value of materials consumed in the production of the imported goods.

values.name: Maximum charge
values.description: Maximum charge The maximum amount that can be charged for a service or product.

values.name: Message total monetary amount
values.description: Message total monetary amount The total of all monetary amounts contained within the message.

values.name: Minimum charge
values.description: Minimum charge The minimum amount that can be charged for a service or product.

values.name: National preference basis amount
values.description: National preference basis amount Amount giving the basis for national preference calculation.

values.name: Negative collected balance
values.description: Negative collected balance Having a quantity of less than zero in an account.

values.name: Negative ledger balance
values.description: Negative ledger balance For an asset account, this would be when the account had a credit balance. For liability and owner's equity accounts, it would be when the account had a debit balance.

values.name: Net adjustment
values.description: Net adjustment The end-of-the-period total amount which is left after recording appropriate adjusting entries.

values.name: Net fee position
values.description: Net fee position The payments left over after deductions or allowances have been made.

values.name: Net year to date excess (deficit)
values.description: Net year to date excess (deficit) A negative amount of an item.

values.name: No amount of insurance
values.description: No amount of insurance No amount of insurance has been declared for a consignment.

values.name: No declared value for carriage
values.description: No declared value for carriage No value has been declared for purposes of carriage.

values.name: No declared value for Customs
values.description: No declared value for Customs No value has been declared for Customs purposes.

values.name: Quotation total amount
values.description: Quotation total amount [5210] Total monetary amount of a quotation.

values.name: Original amount
values.description: Original amount Original amount, without charges, allowances or adjustment.

values.name: Other charges at destination
values.description: Other charges at destination Code to indicate charges levied at destination.

values.name: Other charges due agent
values.description: Other charges due agent Code to indicate that certain charges accrue to an agent.

values.name: Other charges due carrier
values.description: Other charges due carrier Code to indicate that certain charges accrue to a carrier.

values.name: Other commissions
values.description: Other commissions Other commissions paid by the importer to his/her agent in relation to the goods being imported.

values.name: Other deductible charges
values.description: Other deductible charges Other charges deducted from the total invoice value.

values.name: Other transport charges
values.description: Other transport charges (5290) Other charges paid for transport.

values.name: Other valuation charges (Customs)
values.description: Other valuation charges (Customs) Other valuation charges which are payable by reason of the importation or sale of the goods in the Customs territory.

values.name: Packing cost
values.description: Packing cost Cost for packing concerning labour and/or material.

values.name: Transport equipment total for customs packing cost amount
values.description: Transport equipment total for customs packing cost amount [5448] Costs incurred for all containers and coverings of whatever nature which are considered as being one for Customs purposes with the goods, and the cost of packing whether for labour or material.

values.name: Parts incorporated in imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Parts incorporated in imported goods (Customs) Materials, components, parts and similar items incorporated in the imported goods.

values.name: Payment discount amount
values.description: Payment discount amount Discount for paying early.

values.name: Pick-up fee
values.description: Pick-up fee Fee incurring if item has been or will be picked up.

values.name: Positive collected balance
values.description: Positive collected balance Having a quantity of greater than zero in an account.

values.name: Positive ledger balance
values.description: Positive ledger balance For an asset account, this would be when the account had a debit balance. For liability and owner's equity accounts, it would be when the account had a credit balance.

values.name: Prepaid amount
values.description: Prepaid amount (5302) Amount which has been prepaid in advance.

values.name: Prepaid charge summary total
values.description: Prepaid charge summary total Total of all prepaid charges.

values.name: Prepaid taxes total
values.description: Prepaid taxes total Total of all prepaid taxes.

values.name: Purchase amount
values.description: Purchase amount The cost of buying goods or services.

values.name: Quantity discount
values.description: Quantity discount Discount given for purchase of goods in bulk.

values.name: Quota value
values.description: Quota value The monetary value of a quota.

values.name: Received amount
values.description: Received amount The amount is what the bank received, and the one before charges/allowances.

values.name: Sales tax
values.description: Sales tax Identifies the amount of sales tax payable.

values.name: Shipment value in domestic currency
values.description: Shipment value in domestic currency The cost of transportation in domestic currency.

values.name: Specific amount payable
values.description: Specific amount payable Amount that the consignor agrees to be invoiced or to pay. This amount is part of the total charges applied to the consignment.

values.name: Goods item for statistics declared value amount
values.description: Goods item for statistics declared value amount [5218] Value declared for statistical purposes of those goods in a consignment which have the same statistical heading.

values.name: Tax amount
values.description: Tax amount Tax imposed by government or other official authority related to the weight/volume charge or valuation charge.

values.name: Taxable amount
values.description: Taxable amount Amount on which a tax has to be applied.

values.name: To collect
values.description: To collect Amount that has to be collected.

values.name: Tools used in production of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Tools used in production of imported goods (Customs) Tools, dies, moulds and similar items used in the production of the imported goods.

values.name: Total amount
values.description: Total amount The amount specified is the total amount.

values.name: Total amount subject to payment discount
values.description: Total amount subject to payment discount Part of the invoice amount which is subject to payment discount.

values.name: Total charge due
values.description: Total charge due Total amount of charges payable to the carrier.

values.name: Total charges/allowances
values.description: Total charges/allowances The amount specified is the total of all charges/allowances.

values.name: Total collect charges
values.description: Total collect charges Total charges to be collected.

values.name: Total collect charges at destination
values.description: Total collect charges at destination Total charges to be collected at destination.

values.name: Total declared
values.description: Total declared The total value of declared amounts.

values.name: Total freight due
values.description: Total freight due Total amount of freight costs payable to the carrier.

values.name: Total invoice additional amount
values.description: Total invoice additional amount (5140) Amount to be added to the sum of invoice line amounts to arrive at the total invoice amount.

values.name: Damage protection plan coverage
values.description: Damage protection plan coverage Indicates the amount of damage coverage provided under the Damage Protection Plan (DPP).

values.name: Total monetary discount amount
values.description: Total monetary discount amount Total of monetary discount amounts.

values.name: Total payment amount
values.description: Total payment amount A complete charge for goods or services rendered.

values.name: Total service charge
values.description: Total service charge The complete payment owed to one who has performed work for another.

values.name: Cost, insurance and freight (CIF) value
values.description: Cost, insurance and freight (CIF) value Identifies the value of cost, insurance and freight. (Refer to ICC Incoterm CIF for an expanded definition).

values.name: Trade discount
values.description: Trade discount Discount given to any purchaser at a particular commercial level e.g. at wholesale or retail level.

values.name: Transfer amount
values.description: Transfer amount The amount which has been transferred from buyer to the sellers bank.

values.name: Transport charges (Customs)
values.description: Transport charges (Customs) (5290) Cost incurred by shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage, see UN/ECE Recommendation No 23. Synonym: freight charges (Customs).

values.name: Transport charges incurred outside Customs territory
values.description: Transport charges incurred outside Customs territory (5290) Transport charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Unit price
values.description: Unit price (5110) Reporting monetary amount is a "per unit" amount.

values.name: Acceptable quotation fluctuation amount
values.description: Acceptable quotation fluctuation amount The maximum increase or decrease in constituent material fluctuation which will not result in an item price renegotiation.

values.name: Total payments under guarantee
values.description: Total payments under guarantee Total amount paid under guarantee, such as under a factor's guarantee.

values.name: Valuation charge
values.description: Valuation charge A charge based on the value of goods or cargo.

values.name: Value added tax amount
values.description: Value added tax amount [5490] Amount in national currency resulting from the application, at the appropriate rate, of value added tax (or similar tax) to the invoice amount subject to such tax.

values.name: Consignment insured value amount
values.description: Consignment insured value amount [5011] Representation in figures of the total sum covered by an insurance for a particular shipment.

values.name: Subsequent resale of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Subsequent resale of imported goods (Customs) Value of any part of the proceeds of any subsequent resale, disposal or use of the imported goods that accrues, directly or indirectly, to the seller.

values.name: Weight charge
values.description: Weight charge A charge based on the weight of goods or cargo.

values.name: Amount to be collected
values.description: Amount to be collected The monetary amount that is to be collected.

values.name: Standard duty
values.description: Standard duty Standard Customs duty that would apply if special provisions did not apply.

values.name: G-Amount
values.description: G-Amount Amount out of total invoice amount being paid into a blocked account.

values.name: Insurance value
values.description: Insurance value (5010) Value for which the goods are insured.

values.name: Insurance and transport charges incurred inside Customs
values.description: Insurance and transport charges incurred inside Customs territory (5488)+(5290) Charges to be paid for moving goods, by whatever means, from the point of entry into the Customs territory (within a Customs union: to the point of entry in the final destination country).

values.name: Licence (value deducted)
values.description: Licence (value deducted) Amount in the currency of the licence to be written off from the total licence value.

values.name: Other costs
values.description: Other costs (5346) Costs, other than packing, freight and insurance costs, specified separately.

values.name: Duty, tax or fee amount
values.description: Duty, tax or fee amount Amount of duty, tax or fee.

values.name: Customs duty paid
values.description: Customs duty paid Amount which can be deducted from the stated invoice price where that price includes the Customs duty amount.

values.name: Wage tax share
values.description: Wage tax share Wage tax share of total amount to be paid directly to tax collector.

values.name: Social securities premiums share
values.description: Social securities premiums share Social securities share of total amount to be paid directly to the social securities collector.

values.name: Adjustment amount
values.description: Adjustment amount Amount being the balance of the amount to be adjusted and the adjusted amount.

values.name: Guarantee amount (Customs)
values.description: Guarantee amount (Customs) Amount of the guarantee placed with Customs.

values.name: Actual versus calculated price difference
values.description: Actual versus calculated price difference Difference between actual and calculated price.

values.name: Tax sub-totals
values.description: Tax sub-totals A sub total of tax values.

values.name: Alternate currency total amount
values.description: Alternate currency total amount The total amount as expressed in an alternate currency.

values.name: Document amount
values.description: Document amount The monetary value stated within a related document.

values.name: Total reassignments of factored invoices
values.description: Total reassignments of factored invoices Total amount of factored invoices and credit notes reassigned to the seller or to another factor.

values.name: Stated amount
values.description: Stated amount The monetary amount that has been declared.

values.name: Minimum amount
values.description: Minimum amount Lowest possible value; minimum.

values.name: Balance brought forward
values.description: Balance brought forward [5190] Opening balance of the account brought forward from the prior accounting period.

values.name: Message total additional amount
values.description: Message total additional amount An amount in addition to the total message value.

values.name: Message total duty/tax/fee amount
values.description: Message total duty/tax/fee amount Total of all duty/tax/fee amounts.

values.name: Message total amount prepaid
values.description: Message total amount prepaid Total of all prepaid amounts within the message.

values.name: Exact amount
values.description: Exact amount Specific amount.

values.name: Maximum amount
values.description: Maximum amount Highest possible value; maximum.

values.name: Amount up to
values.description: Amount up to Highest possible value; up to.

values.name: Amount not exceeding
values.description: Amount not exceeding Highest possible value; not exceeding.

values.name: Any other specification/tolerance
values.description: Any other specification/tolerance Any further qualification of the amount.

values.name: No specification/tolerance
values.description: No specification/tolerance No further qualification of the amount.

values.name: Final net acquisition cost
values.description: Final net acquisition cost The final cost of acquisition, net of all add-ons and discounts.

values.name: Labour cost
values.description: Labour cost The cost of providing labour to complete a task.

values.name: Material cost
values.description: Material cost The cost of materials needed to complete a task.

values.name: Other cost
values.description: Other cost Non specific costs for an item in addition to those stated explicitly.

values.name: Overhead cost
values.description: Overhead cost The cost of overhead when completing a task.

values.name: Packaging cost
values.description: Packaging cost The cost of packaging an item.

values.name: Prototype set up cost
values.description: Prototype set up cost The cost of setting up a prototype.

values.name: Authorized cleaning amount
values.description: Authorized cleaning amount Amount of money authorized for cleaning services.

values.name: Raw material per cart cost
values.description: Raw material per cart cost The cost of raw material expressed per cart.

values.name: Raw material per unit of measure cost
values.description: Raw material per unit of measure cost The cost of raw material expressed per unit of measure.

values.name: Total die model cost
values.description: Total die model cost The total of costs for a die model.

values.name: Total gauge cost
values.description: Total gauge cost The total of costs for a gauge.

values.name: Total material including purchased components cost
values.description: Total material including purchased components cost The total cost of materials for an item, including components purchased externally.

values.name: Total purchased components cost
values.description: Total purchased components cost The total cost of components purchased externally.

values.name: Total tooling cost
values.description: Total tooling cost The total of costs relating to tooling.

values.name: Delivery limitation amount
values.description: Delivery limitation amount The monetary limitation amount for a delivery.

values.name: Minimum amount due
values.description: Minimum amount due The minimum amount that must be paid on an amount now due for payment.

values.name: Penalty amount
values.description: Penalty amount The penalty charge incurred if or because conditions are not met.

values.name: Interest amount
values.description: Interest amount The amount of interest charged or paid on a debit or credit balance.

values.name: Line item amount
values.description: Line item amount Goods item total minus allowances plus charges for line item. See also Code 66.

values.name: Allowance amount
values.description: Allowance amount An amount deducted in advance in consideration of some specified factor.

values.name: Additional amount covered: freight costs
values.description: Additional amount covered: freight costs Additional amount (freight costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: inspection costs
values.description: Additional amount covered: inspection costs Additional amount (inspection costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: insurance costs
values.description: Additional amount covered: insurance costs Additional amount (insurance costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: interest
values.description: Additional amount covered: interest Additional amount (interest) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Agent commission amount
values.description: Agent commission amount Amount which has to be paid to an agent.

values.name: Credit note amount
values.description: Credit note amount Amount of a credit note.

values.name: Debit note amount
values.description: Debit note amount Amount of a debit note.

values.name: Documentary credit amount
values.description: Documentary credit amount Amount of the documentary credit.

values.name: Part of documentary credit amount
values.description: Part of documentary credit amount Part of documentary credit amount subject to sight payment, deferred payment or acceptance when the documentary credit is available by mixed payment.

values.name: Advance payment at the beginning of works
values.description: Advance payment at the beginning of works Amount paid to the contractor at the beginning of works in the construction to be deducted later.

values.name: Deduction of advance payment amount at the beginning of
values.description: Deduction of advance payment amount at the beginning of works Progressive deduction of advance payment, as works go on.

values.name: Advance payment amount on building material
values.description: Advance payment amount on building material An amount paid in advance for the purchase of building material.

values.name: Deduction of the advance payment amount on building
values.description: Deduction of the advance payment amount on building material The cost of building material less any monies paid in advance.

values.name: Advance payment amount on stock
values.description: Advance payment amount on stock An amount paid in advance for the purchase of stock.

values.name: Deduction of the advance payment amount on stock
values.description: Deduction of the advance payment amount on stock The cost of stock less any monies paid in advance.

values.name: Amount subject to guarantee retention
values.description: Amount subject to guarantee retention Amount participating in the assessment basis of a guarantee retention.

values.name: Amount not subject of guarantee retention
values.description: Amount not subject of guarantee retention Amount not participating in the assessment basis of a guarantee retention.

values.name: Amount subject to contractual retention
values.description: Amount subject to contractual retention Amount participating in the assessment basis of a contractual retention.

values.name: Works amount, initial
values.description: Works amount, initial Total amount of works in the initial contract.

values.name: Works amount, variations
values.description: Works amount, variations Total amount of contract variations, not including the amount planned on initial contract.

values.name: Works amount, total
values.description: Works amount, total Total amount of works, including initial contract and variations.

values.name: Retention amount
values.description: Retention amount The amount of money that has been or is to be retained.

values.name: Deposit
values.description: Deposit Part of the amount of retention, not covered by guarantee of retention, and thus deducted from the amount paid to the contractor until release of retention.

values.name: Deposit refund
